# The sun (generated by make_env.py): a disc facing -X (the camera), 6 m across.
new
material new Sun --base-color 0.788 0.800 0.631 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Sun --vertices 12 --radius 3.0 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 90 0
material assign Sun
select all
shade flat
export sun.glb
